mistakes.text: If he hadn't been so careful, he would have ruined the fruit already.
mistakes.normalized: if he hadn't been so careful he would have ruined the fruit already
mistakes.feedback_sk: Opatrnosť je jeho stála vlastnosť, preto v Mixed Conditional: „if he weren't so careful“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Opatrnost je jeho trvalá vlastnost, proto v Mixed Conditional: „if he weren't so careful“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Being careful is a general trait, so the Mixed Conditional uses “if he weren't so careful”.

mistakes.text: If he weren't so careful, he would ruin the fruit already.
mistakes.normalized: if he weren't so careful he would ruin the fruit already
mistakes.feedback_sk: Škoda by sa už stala („already“), preto „would have ruined“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Škoda by se už stala („already“), proto „would have ruined“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The damage would already have happened (“already”), so use “would have ruined”.

mistakes.text: If he wouldn't be so careful, he would have ruined the fruit already.
mistakes.normalized: if he wouldn't be so careful he would have ruined the fruit already
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; správne je Past Simple: „if he weren't“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; správně je Past Simple: „if he weren't“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; use the Past Simple: “if he weren't”.

mistakes.text: If he isn't so careful, he would have ruined the fruit already.
mistakes.normalized: if he isn't so careful he would have ruined the fruit already
mistakes.feedback_sk: Neskutočnú podmienku v prítomnosti vyjadruje Past Simple: „if he weren't“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Neskutečnou podmínku v přítomnosti vyjadřuje Past Simple: „if he weren't“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An unreal present condition needs the Past Simple: “if he weren't”.

mistakes.text: If he weren't so careful, he would have ruined the fruit yet.
mistakes.normalized: if he weren't so careful he would have ruined the fruit yet
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Už“ v kladnej vete je „already“; „yet“ patrí do záporu a otázok.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Už“ v kladné větě je „already“; „yet“ patří do záporu a otázek.
mistakes.feedback_en: In a positive sentence use “already”; “yet” is for negatives and questions.

source_issues: SK and CZ sentences lack the final full stop.
